verdict.rationale: mParticle has HTTP and platform API documentation pages (Warehouse Sync API overview, Audiences API), but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API explorer or runnable examples such as try-it consoles, live request execution or sandboxed calls. A static API reference does not count as the interactive, runnable capability this story asks for, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
